Property Reference: 3021352.

Suitable for working professionals or small family.

This is a spacious two bedroom first floor flat with a separate living room, kitchen and a bathroom.  It has been well maintained and is offered unfurnished.  There is gas central heating throughout the flat. 

The property is located within easy reach of city centre either by bus or tram. It is served locally by shops, bars, restaurants and cafes.

Ocean Terminal shopping centre and a local Tesco Express for any shopping requirements are also just a short journey away and there are excellent bus and tram links around the city from nearby Leith Walk which is just minutes away.
